Running the accepted command fails with `unrecognized arguments: --profile=core --report`. Recommendation: add the F001 profile-aware path and F004 report flags to `_doctor_main`, or delegate the console subcommand to the canonical doctor script path, and add a regression test for `dontpanic doctor --profile=core --report --report-path`.
